g.text: Power flags denote external supply or passive-filter transfer; they are not protection devices.

g.desc: Power flags denote external supply or passive-filter transfer; they are not protection devices.

g.text: Passive parts: identities and net labels are authoritative; one-decoupler-per-pin layout remains a PCB obligation.

g.desc: Passive parts: identities and net labels are authoritative; one-decoupler-per-pin layout remains a PCB obligation.

g.text: HEAD-CTRL02 / 7 RH arm slaves + 1 head EtherCAT slave / P16 DC branch only

g.desc: HEAD-CTRL02 / 7 RH arm slaves + 1 head EtherCAT slave / P16 DC branch only

g.text: SCHEMATIC CANDIDATE. No PCB. No safety, thermal, regeneration, manufacturing or 2kg-grasp release.

g.desc: SCHEMATIC CANDIDATE. No PCB. No safety, thermal, regeneration, manufacturing or 2kg-grasp release.

g.text: Motor outputs OUT1/OUT2 are a floating H-bridge pair. RH B brakes use RH DC input; RH14 N has no brake.

g.desc: Motor outputs OUT1/OUT2 are a floating H-bridge pair. RH B brakes use RH DC input; RH14 N has no brake.

g.text: Connectors: full mating envelopes NOT fitted in MCAD; magjacks are bench candidates

g.desc: Connectors: full mating envelopes NOT fitted in MCAD; magjacks are bench candidates

g.text: LED VIO + five VLED switches; SPI6 CS / 5 temperatures

g.desc: LED VIO + five VLED switches; SPI6 CS / 5 temperatures

g.text: Four independent PH/EN motor channels and powered-off current-monitor isolation

g.desc: Four independent PH/EN motor channels and powered-off current-monitor isolation
